# Too Bold

*Wilf the spore gatherer will not go back into the Deepwood alone: the Hoarder Shrooms on the Humming Trail have grown too bold. Gather 15 Wild Spores from the patches there and defeat 40 Hoarder Shrooms.*

## Objectives

- Gather 15 [Wild Spore](../items/wild_spore.md)

- 15,000 EXP
- 4,000 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10
